faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati JRF (GATE) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Guwahati JRF (GATE) recruitment is 12th August 2026. Ensure all details are accurate before the deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the JRF (GATE) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the JRF (GATE) position will receive a monthly salary ranging from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 45,650, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications for the JRF (GATE) position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course, selected through NET (CSIR-UGC NET) including Lectureship, GATE, or equivalent national-level examinations.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive by IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the JRF (GATE) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) position, specifically for candidates who have qualified through GATE.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the JRF (GATE) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JRF (GATE) position at IIT Guwahati will primarily involve an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications.

faq.question: Q7. Where is IIT Guwahati located?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The JRF (GATE) position at IIT Guwahati is a contractual role. This means the employment is for a fixed tenure.

faq.question: Q9. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications for the IIT Guwahati JRF (GATE) recruitment must be submitted online. Candidates are advised to use the official website or the provided link.

faq.question: Q10. When will the shortlisted candidates be informed?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates for the JRF (GATE) position will be informed via email on 12th August 2026, the same day as the application deadline.
